classification.rationale: Well-made knit polyester costumes are wearing apparel rather than festive articles of 9505, which covers only flimsy, non-durable costumes. For infant sizes, heading 6111 (babies' garments, knitted) applies, in 6111.30.50 as synthetic fiber garments. A jumpsuit with headpiece is reported as a set, suffix .20. NY N107290 (in force) classified an infant knit polyester costume of jumpsuit and hat in 6111.30.5020 and a toddler-size costume in 6114.30.
